_comment: Reference stdio configuration for the MCP servers this tree actually ships.
The AIASK packages live in a conda env named by AIASK_CONDA_ENV (default
'aiask'); scripts/run_mcp_stdio.py resolves that env and re-execs its
interpreter. Set AIASK_VENV_PYTHON only to override the choice outright.
AIASK_PROJECT_ROOT should be this repository root. Broker servers are
disabled by default: live trading stays off until explicitly armed.

aiask-akshare.description: AKShare MCP: market/finance data, valuation, research, quant, strategy (144 tools in the tool-only profile set here; 179 in the full profile)

aiask-strategy-factory.description: Strategy factory control plane: catalog, status, runs, readiness (read-only)

aiask-tonghuashun.description: Tonghuashun; order paths are token- and confirmation-guarded

aiask-qmt.description: QMT; live trading path, disabled by default
